provenance.evaluatorHashMethod: SHA-256 of UTF-8 evaluator source with CRLF normalized to LF; frozen fixture/input hashes remain byte-exact.

signoff.note: triumph! approved this seed in chat for eval run #1. Issue checkboxes stay open. Outside authorship is still 0/34. Planted bank-feed cases, the spoken-approval rejection, the legitimate Cedar bank change, and the dispute, bankruptcy, and opt-out stops are executed and graded against plantedRule. The permanently closed case is graded from a stubbed Apify transport and a fixture credit score: closed wins, and the source URL and timestamp stay on the audit. The two-payment plan is persisted by the gateway, and the first installment becomes partially paid only after an exact sandbox reconciliation. The four-payment exception is denied by a software passkey, and the only saved plan is two payments with the fee kept. A software passkey denies the half-off request, and the full-pay and two-payment offers both keep the $4,950 total. The pay-in-full link is refused before identity and the sandbox receipt is recorded only after identity and an exact reconciliation. The unverified vendor stays held when the fixture footprint has no website and no operating listing, and its invoice is not paid. CRS and Apify checks are fixtures, not live calls. Other integration steps are not executed.

scope.apRuntime: Production ClaudeAgentRuntime + Dispatcher + role registry + handoff store + in-memory usage ledger; injected scripted QueryFn.
scope.arRuntime: Real collections permit and reconciler/auditor DomainTools; direct tool-script seam, not dispatcher or voice conversation.
scope.extraction: Oracle-fed fixture mock; schema and evidence fidelity only. 8 equally weighted fields per AP item; lineItems is one exact-match field; absent optional adjustment matches absent.
scope.providers: Synthetic GX10, bank, CRS public-records and Apify responses. No network calls, keys, real calls or money. Positive runtime cost entries are synthetic accounting tests, not spend.
scope.fraudDefinition: Only key steps with LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN; one planted fraud item. Sanctions and routine bank-change holds are not relabeled fraud.
scope.payablesDefinition: Keyed invoice initial pay/hold decisions and P08 evidence gate; includes P03 sender variants. P04 has a separate two-dispatcher-run bank application measurement. P10 probes Collections tool isolation; NOT_IN_BADGE stays a separate direct policy reference. P11 measures expired memory activation takeover after a persisted mock receipt and with the stale runner parked before payment I/O (synchronous effect fence), not an OS kill or durable restart. P12 replays keyed AP steps of its comparison scenarios with GX10 healthy, then cut, and requires the same outcome vector.
scope.recovery: Production runtime/dispatcher, expired-activation takeover and Payables replay on retained memory state. Scripted query abandoned before provider I/O or after a persisted mock receipt, before handoff/completion; no OS process kill, durable restart, uncertain debit retry or real provider debit.
scope.arConversations: Production collections planner (mock CallStarter), real tool gateway handler/store, production Dispatcher + ClaudeAgentRuntime with scripted QueryFn for post-call, reconciler and auditor. Scripted caller lines and voice-agent tool choices; no Cartesia, phone, model or bank network.
scope.gx10Failover: Production Dispatcher/ClaudeAgentRuntime per keyed step, twice on fresh snapshots. Cut run: every GX10 request fails, local_extract falls back once through the production router (createRouter, field_extraction) to a canned Anthropic transport; route, model, latency and synthetic cost are audited as extraction_routed with ROUTE_FALLBACK. Only the document text and extraction schema are sent. No network, key or spend; this is not a live link cut.
scope.pdfExtraction: Text layer of 83 fixture invoice PDFs (pdfium) through the production router local field_extraction route on shared GX10 gpt-oss:20b, production 0.7 confidence gate, cloud fallback refused, a fresh router per document with a 60 s timeout (production uses 8 s and demotes GX10 above a 5 s median; counts reported). Scored 7 document-printed fields per invoice by exact match after cosmetic normalisation; vendorId and bankAccountId are not printed and are resolved by code from the vendor master. Image/vision reading is not measured. Recorded 2026-10-24T18:51:17.743Z at 9a191ff; p50 2850 ms. An earlier attempt hit a ~10 s cold model load, which the production router treats as a GX10 demotion (5 s median) and an 8 s timeout.
scope.precallStops: Production Collections planner tools + ClaudeAgentRuntime (scripted QueryFn tries start_call) and the production dial path createDialCallStarter -> dialCollectionCall over a provider stub. UI call-button state, email-only follow-up, live CRS/Apify evidence and real Cartesia are not executed. Scenarios: C11, C13, C14, C15, C16, C22.
scope.callButton: Production runPreCall on fixture credit/health/planner deps (credit ofac unknown blocks as Credit/OFAC check unavailable; clear ofac reaches a local plan). The result is published like services.preCall and read through parsePreCallGate by createAdminDial. createCallRequestHTTP unlocks an operator session and POSTs the collections line; its fetch posts to that admin dial and returns the admin status/body. dial() is a stub that records providerRequest() and performs no HTTP. A body that includes a phone number is rejected before the relay. No CRS, Apify, model, or live dial.
scope.badgeAttack: Production Collections planner + Dispatcher/ClaudeAgentRuntime with scripted QueryFn and real PreToolUse/schema gates. No payment tool or bank adapter is available; no payment execution or human/voice approval is claimed. Policy NOT_IN_BADGE is a separate direct evaluator reference.
scope.bankChange: Scripted QueryFn through production runtime/dispatcher; production VendorSeat/ControllerApprovals; software passkey, fixture CRS/Apify and bank. No human tap or live provider proof.
scope.falseHoldDefinition: Keyed ALLOW invoice steps held / all keyed ALLOW invoice steps. Historical paid invoices excluded from this denominator.
scope.unscored: The 83 raw AP runs and 10 AR runs are coverage, not 93 labeled ground-truth decisions. Only explicit answer-key labels count toward accuracy.
